channel.title: GM Research
channel.description: Daily intelligence briefings on markets, law, AI, biohacking, trading and more.

item.title: Precedent: CFTC Moves to Bless Most Sports Event Contracts as Kentucky Sues Kalshi and Polymarket
item.description: A 267-page CFTC proposal would permit most sports event contracts just as Kentucky sued Kalshi and Polymarket — escalating the federal-versus-state preemption war.

item.title: Cortex: GPT-5.6's favored ship Tuesday is today; Fable 5 dark on day 11 (57% restore by Jul 1)
item.description: Polymarket puts ~83% on GPT-5.6 launching this week, today the favored day. Fable 5 still dark worldwide on day 11 — the June 23 credit cliff is moot. TAO $230; AKT still bid.

item.title: Praxis: AI's productivity gains carry a hidden tax: strain, sameness, and a satisfaction divide
item.description: Three 2026 studies converge: BCG's AI 'joy paradox,' a creativity-monoculture meta-analysis, and a satisfaction divide — the fix is context engineering, not prompting.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: The classroom map that made Africa small has been lying to us for 400 years
item.description: Mercator's 1569 sailors' tool stretched polar landmasses into giants. It ended up in classrooms worldwide, quietly making Europe look bigger than it was.

item.title: Morning Edge: Intel +10.6% on Apple Chip Deal as BTC Coils at $64K
item.description: Nasdaq +2.5% on AI semiconductor momentum; BTC funding at 93rd percentile in Extreme Fear signals a potential spring setup above $64,550.

item.title: Precedent: World Liberty Nears an OCC Trust-Bank Charter, Igniting the Crypto Charter War
item.description: OCC approval of Trump-linked World Liberty's USD1 trust bank looks imminent as the ABA weighs a lawsuit and Warren calls the charters illegal.

item.title: Cortex: Fable 5 leaves Pro/Max plans today — June 23 it bills at $10/$50 per M tokens
item.description: Last free day for Fable 5 on subscription tiers; from June 23 it draws usage credits at API rates, double Opus 4.8. TAO bounces +3% off the flush; AKT finally rolls over.

item.title: Biohacker: Urolithin A reverses immune aging markers in 28 days — plus BFR matches heavy-load hypertrophy at low intensity
item.description: Nature Aging RCT (n=50): urolithin A 1g/day expands CD8+ T cell mitochondrial capacity in 28 days. BFR matches hypertrophy at low loads. Isocaloric TRE shows no metabolic benefit.

item.title: Alpha: Stop clusters and magnet zones: the resting-order pools that pull price
item.description: Stop-loss orders pile up at equal highs and lows, forming liquidity pools price gets magnetically pulled toward and swept before reversing. Trade the reaction, not the spike.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: Every physics textbook teaches the Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapse wrong
item.description: The Federal Works Administration investigators explicitly rejected resonance. The real cause — aeroelastic flutter — is stranger and more dangerous.

item.title: Morning Edge: BTC $63.8K Claws Back From Extreme Fear as SPX Hits 7,500 Weekly Close
item.description: Equities ripped Friday led by INTC +10.6% on Apple foundry deal as BTC recovered from $62K; Warsh holds rates hawkish as Iran ceasefire talks stall and WTI drops -3.8%.

item.title: Precedent: ESMA Pivots From Writing MiCA to Enforcing It as the July 1 CASP Cliff Nears
item.description: ESMA's 17 June annual report frames the shift from drafting crypto rules to enforcing them — 10 days before MiCA's transition expires and unlicensed CASPs must wind down.

item.title: Cortex: SpaceX buys Cursor for $60B; Fable 5 still dark on day 10 as TAO round-trips −15%
item.description: Largest AI dev-tool deal ever: SpaceX takes Cursor all-stock. Fable 5/Mythos 5 stay suspended pending US export talks; TAO −15.3% 7d, AKT +7.6% the lone basket holdout.

item.title: Praxis: The bottleneck moved: AI's real limit is power, not chips
item.description: The IEA says grid power, not chips, now gates AI; a 2025 study ties heavy AI use to weaker thinking; prediction markets top $20B/mo. Work the real constraint.

item.title: Alpha: Large Prints & Block Trades: reading institutional size on the tape
item.description: A large print is an outsized single execution on the tape; a block trade is size crossed off the book and reported late — both mark where real money is positioned.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: Making coal engines more efficient caused Britain to burn more coal — not less
item.description: William Stanley Jevons discovered the efficiency trap in 1865: cheaper resources don’t get conserved — they get used more. The same paradox now governs AI, highways, and LEDs.

item.title: Morning Edge: BTC at $62K as Iran deal collapses at Burgenstock — Extreme Fear 15, Monday gap risk elevated
item.description: SPX closed Thu at 7,500 (Juneteenth holiday), BTC slid to $62,201 as Iran walked out of Burgenstock — F&G: 15 (Extreme Fear), WTI at $77, Monday open is the reckoning.

item.title: Precedent: CLARITY Act Faces August Recess Cliff as Senate Calendar Tightens
item.description: The market-structure bill cleared Senate Banking 15-9 but has ~8 weeks before recess. GENIUS Act races an 18 July statutory deadline; MiCA's July 1 hard cliff hits in 11 days.

item.title: Cortex: GLM-5.2 beats GPT-5.5 on coding; Fable/Mythos day 9 dark; Anthropic Seoul opens
item.description: Z.AI GLM-5.2 (753B, MIT) beats GPT-5.5 on FrontierSWE at 1/6th the cost. Fable 5 and Mythos 5 enter day 9 suspended. Anthropic lands Seoul with NAVER, Samsung SDS, LG CNS + 3 more.

item.title: Biohacker: Youthful gut microbiome reverses liver aging in mice — plus ACSM rewrites resistance training rules after 17 years
item.description: DDW 2026: autologous FMT prevents hepatocellular carcinoma and reverses mitochondrial decline. ACSM 2026 Position Stand (137 reviews, 30k+ participants) kills the training-to-failure myth.

item.title: Alpha: Speed of Tape: read how fast prints hit, not just where price goes
item.description: Tape speed is prints-per-second — the velocity of executions. Acceleration marks breakouts; a sudden slowdown after a run flags exhaustion before the chart shows it.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: Two Texas oilmen accumulated a third of the world's silver — then the exchange changed the rules
item.description: In 1980, Nelson Bunker Hunt and his brother controlled 195 million ounces of silver, drove the price from $6 to $50, and nearly took down the US financial system on their way down.

item.title: Morning Edge: BTC extends post-Warsh slide to $63K as Extreme Fear grips crypto and equities decouple
item.description: SPX +1% as VIX implodes to 16.4 while BTC slides to $63,057 — F&G hits 20 (Extreme Fear), INTC breaks a 26-year high, and markets now price zero Fed cuts in 2026.

item.title: Precedent: SEC Votes to Scrap Reg NMS Rule 611 — a Landmark Unlock for Tokenized US Stocks
item.description: The SEC voted 11 June to propose scrapping the 20-year-old Order Protection Rule — the structural barrier keeping tokenized US stocks off DeFi venues. Comment period now open.

item.title: Cortex: Anthropic nears deal to restore Fable 5 & Mythos 5 — AI-token rotation reverses
item.description: Anthropic and Trump officials are negotiating a restore — MD Chris Ciauri says 'coming days.' The decentralised-AI trade that rallied on the shutdown reversed: TAO −9%, AKT −11%.

item.title: Praxis: The instrument problem: when the metric overrides your judgment
item.description: Four wearables, one night: deep-sleep readings from 47 to 81 minutes. Goodhart's Law, the Stoics, and the discipline of calibration — knowing a metric's error bars before acting.

item.title: Alpha: Liquidity Voids: the order-book air pockets price falls through on thin books
item.description: A liquidity void is a price band with almost no resting orders — flow rips through it with little resistance. On thin-book days like today's BTC, that's where gaps and traps form.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: The doctor who proved handwashing saves lives was beaten to death in an asylum
item.description: In 1847, Ignaz Semmelweis cut a maternity ward's death rate from 18% to 1% — and his colleagues destroyed him for it.

item.title: Morning Edge: Post-FOMC Hangover: BTC Slips to $64.3K as Warsh Hawkish Hold Bites
item.description: Warsh drops the Fed cutting bias and signals a 2026 hike — equities fall 1.2%, VIX spikes 12%, BTC surrenders $65.7K. Iran deal today could cap damage via lower oil.

item.title: Precedent: US Export-Control Order Forces Anthropic to Pull Fable 5 and Mythos 5 Worldwide
item.description: A non-public Commerce/BIS "is-informed" directive — the first export control applied to a live, deployed AI model — barred all non-US nationals, so Anthropic disabled both models.

item.title: Cortex: US export order yanks Claude Fable 5 three days after launch; AI-tokens rip 24–39%
item.description: A US security directive disabled Fable 5 + Mythos 5 for all users over a codebase jailbreak; the shutdown rotated capital into decentralised-AI tokens — TAO +24% wk, AKT +39% wk.

item.title: Biohacker: VO2max sweet spot confirmed: 70th percentile protects telomeres as well as elite fitness — plus KIHD sauna mortality data
item.description: Ryall & Denham 2025 meta-analysis shows moderate CRF suffices for telomere maintenance; BJSM meta-analysis (n=398,716) confirms fitness outweighs BMI for longevity

item.title: Alpha: Maker vs Taker: who provides liquidity, who pays for it
item.description: Makers post resting limit orders and earn the spread; takers cross it for instant fills and pay the fee. In fear regimes makers pull quotes first — books thin, slippage spikes.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: Every ancient language had words for black, white, red, and green — but not blue
item.description: Homer's sea was 'wine-dark,' never blue. Every ancient language had the same gap. Blue is always named last — and the reason reveals something strange about how we perceive colour.

item.title: Morning Edge: FOMC Decision Day: Warsh Drops Easing Bias, BTC Holds $65.7K
item.description: Warsh's first rate decision arrives 2pm EDT tonight; NDX shed -1.9% in day-1 FOMC session while BTC sits $380 above a $145M long-liquidation cluster.

item.title: Precedent: CLARITY Act Enters 'Do or Die' Zone as 200+ Firms Demand Senate Floor Vote Before July Recess
item.description: MiCA T-14: Only 194 CASPs licensed across EU as July 1 hard stop looms; GENIUS Act final-rule clock ticks with Federal Reserve silent.

item.title: Cortex: Anthropic disables Fable 5 and Mythos 5 worldwide under US export order
item.description: Its top model (95.0% SWE-bench Verified) went dark 3 days after launch over a jailbreak. The rotation drove TAO +20.6% this week; Anthropic also files to IPO at $965B.

item.title: Praxis: Average Looks Out. Elite Looks In.
item.description: Housel, Clear, Lamade, and Mollick each arrive at the same discipline in June 2026: the instinct to look outward at rivals, odds, and AI is the root of poor decisions and lost agency.

item.title: Alpha: Open Interest Dynamics: read OI against price to separate new money from short-covering
item.description: Open interest counts live contracts, not trades. Read against price, it splits a real trend from a hollow short-covering bounce — and flags crowded books before they cascade.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: The crayfish that cloned itself into a new species — in a German fish tank
item.description: A single chromosome accident in the 1990s created an animal that reproduces without males. Every marbled crayfish alive is a clone of that one original animal, now colonising continents.

item.title: Morning Edge: FOMC Eve: NASDAQ +3%, BTC breaks $66K stall into Warsh debut
item.description: Kevin Warsh chairs his first FOMC tomorrow; VIX crushed to 16.2, NASDAQ +3.07% — but a $411M BTC long liq wall at $65.2K means the breakout needs FOMC confirmation.

item.title: Alpha: Footprint Charts: Reading Bid/Ask Volume Inside Every Candle
item.description: Footprint charts expose bid vs. ask volume at each price level inside a bar — the only tool that reveals absorption, stacked imbalances, and delta divergence as they form.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: Fritz Haber invented the process that feeds half the world — then directed the first large-scale chemical weapons attack in history
item.description: The same chemist who invented fertilizer for half the world also directed WWI's first poison gas attack and died in exile as the Nazis used his chemistry against his own family.

item.title: Morning Edge: Iran talks drive WTI -3.8% and Nikkei +2.8% — BTC stalls at $63.9K pre-FOMC
item.description: Iran peace talks push WTI -3.8% and fire Asian equities, but BTC sits flat at $63.9K with ETH funding at its 7-day peak. FOMC Jun 17-18 next; 83.5% odds BTC hits $65K in June.

item.title: Precedent: CFTC Proposes the First US Prediction-Markets Rule, Banning War and Terror Contracts
item.description: The CFTC's 10 June NPRM sets a public-interest test for event contracts on Kalshi, Polymarket and Crypto.com, asserting federal preemption over state gambling bans.

item.title: Cortex: Claude 4.0 retires and the Agent SDK splits billing — both land today, June 15
item.description: Original Opus 4 / Sonnet 4 hit end-of-life and programmatic usage moves to a separate credit pool. SWE-bench Pro is the metric now — Fable 5 leads 80.3%. TAO holds $263.

item.title: Praxis: When answers go free: where knowledge work's value migrates
item.description: Tim Ferriss's how-to catalog is down ~80% since 2022 as LLMs eat prescriptive content; the durable edge is understanding, judgment, and history-plus-frontier synthesis.

item.title: Alpha: Spoofing: order-book walls placed only to be cancelled before they fill
item.description: Spoofing posts large limit orders with intent to cancel — a false story painted on the book. The four tells that separate a bait wall from genuine resting size.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: The geneticist who proved genes can jump — and was ignored for 30 years
item.description: Barbara McClintock discovered mobile DNA in 1950 and was dismissed as a crank. Half your genome is made of the elements she found.

item.title: Morning Edge: WTI -7% supply shock fuels global rally — BTC knife-edge at $64K before FOMC
item.description: OPEC+ ramp deflates crude 7%, Nikkei surges +2.8%, VIX hits 17.68 — BTC sits on a knife-edge at $64K with $123M longs at risk below and FOMC pins risk this weekend.
